scene: The arch leads outside to a multi-depot transit hub!
picture: A flat side view along a concrete depot platform. Far left, a moored brass airship with an extended ramp waits to launch. Left, the girl sits in her purple wheelchair. Centre, a yellow delivery truck with open doors idles on the platform. Right, a colourful steam train puffs pink smoke along tracks.
shown: A moored brass airship with an open gangplank waits far left.
An idling yellow delivery truck with open rear doors sits centre.
A striped steam train puffing sweet pink smoke stands right.
